QuestInfo.name: [Kritias] Serving Boy
QuestInfo.1: Ian suggests you try distracting Parma so you can speak to the princess. Buy a #bFancy Handkerchief#k from #bCliff#k in town and give it to Parma.
QuestInfo.2: Parma left to deliver the Fancy Handkerchief to the princess... or so she claimed. This is your chance to speak to the princess in person.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary:
#Wbasic#
#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0#  34,557,538
Can proceed to [Kritias] The Request of a Princess

0.0: Sorry that maid was so rude to you. Women, am I right? I mean, she's just trying to keep the princess safe. She takes it a little too far is all.
0.1: She'll never let you see the princess, though. But I have an idea. Are you ready to do things the manly way?

yes.0: #bCliff#k over there sells #bFancy Handkerchiefs#k. Give one to Parma and say it's for the princess. She'll run off, and then you can sneak over to meet the princess.

no.0: So you DON'T want to meet the princess? I see...

1.0: You again? As I've already told you, the princess will not be seeing anyone today.\r\n#L0##bI have an offering for the princess.#l\n#k
1.1: This handkerchief... It's her favorite. Yes, she'll want this right away. No time to waste! Excuse me!

yes.0: (Parma scuttles away. But the princess is in the other direction... Odd. But this is your chance to talk to Princess #bMiriam#k!)

npc.0: You'll want to get that #bFancy Handkerchief#k from #bCliff#k, then hand it to Parma.

item.0: I insist you leave at once. The princess must get her rest, and I won't have you breathing her precious air.
